name: Kurama
source:
He is arrogant, and he hates boredom. As the price of saving the near-death Yoshitsune, he asks “taking your soul after your death” for return. He doesn’t really understand the human world, and causes a lot of trouble for people around. He acknowledges the power of Tamamo, and picks a fight with him very often.

Organization: Assisting the rebellion
Interests: Yoshitsune’s training, accumulating shiny things

[From the website character profile.]
